nom: Dr. Brandt Advanced Microdermabrasion Face Exfoliator

avis.titre: Great face scrub that smooths and softens your skinGreat face scrub that smooths and softens your skin
avis.texte: As 40-something year old that was raised in the 1980’s (meaning: played outdoors all the time and never even heard the word “sunscreen”), I am constantly on the lookout for good face moisturizers and skin treatments. Dr. Brandt’s Dermabrasion (No More Needles) was my favorite, although I have tried many other brands as well. This new version (the “Advanced Microdermabrasion”) really works. In the shower (while my hair conditioner is soaking in), I massage it into my face (and upper chest, where I also have sunspots) for 1-2 minutes. I rinse it off while still in the shower and it rinses away completely (no filmy coating left behind) and my skin does not burn (like some face scrubs cause). My skin is noticeably softer after each use, but I immediately follow each use with a good moisturizer. The combination of the Advanced Dr Brandt’s and the serious moisturizer has helped reduce the dry/peeling skin on my forehead, shrink the pores on my nose and chin, and makes my skin so much softer. It is worth every penny, especially when I only use a small amount (about the size of 2 peas?). This tube will last for at least 6-8 months.

avis.titre: Leaves skin super nice and smooth
avis.texte: Leaves your skin super smooth and uniform. Without causing any irritation! I love it.
This company makes one of the best micro dermabrasion products for the money. I absolutely love the results.
By far my favorite facial exfoliator. Will make your skin feel brand new. I have super sensitive skin, and I can use this regularly without any issues.

Love the tiny grit and that it's not slimy. Just a great texture that really makes my face & neck feel like the product did it's job & it feels so smooth afterwards. Love it! Thank you for this product!
This scrub is very nice for me. I feel like it does a nice but not harsh scrub
I have used this scrub through a few packaging iterations for decades and will continue to use it to remove dead skin and clean pore surfaces.

This product delivers a true microdermabrasion-style polish at home. The texture is a fine white cream loaded with uniform abrasive crystals that stay intact during use. The sensation is cool and slightly evaporative, likely from menthyl lactate and alcohol, and the scent reminds me of toothpaste. Used sparingly on damp skin after a gentle cleanse, it feels effective and controlled. The abrasives are persistent, so light pressure is enough, as too much can easily over-exfoliate. I’ve found it works best for me once a week before showering, which makes rinsing away the fine grit easier. Afterward, I stick to calming, hydrating products and avoid acids or retinoids for a day. The result is smooth, refined skin without irritation. While the $79 retail price seems high, the small amount needed per session means the 2.1 oz tube could last me more than a year, giving it better long-term value than it first appears. Overall, this is a strong physical exfoliator for non-sensitive skin and a practical way to achieve professional-level resurfacing at home, provided it’s used with restraint.

avis.titre: Leaves My Skin Noticeably Softer and Brighter After Each Use
avis.texte: I’ve been using the Dr. Brandt Advanced Microdermabrasion Face Exfoliator, and every time I use it, my skin feels noticeably softer and smoother. The formula has a subtle, light, and pleasant scent, and the texture feels high-quality compared to other scrubs I’ve tried. It polishes away dullness without being overly harsh, leaving my skin fresh and glowing. After rinsing, I immediately notice how much brighter and more refined my complexion looks. My makeup applies more evenly on the days I use this, and my moisturizer seems to absorb better too. It has really helped minimize the look of rough texture and dull patches, giving me a more radiant and even finish overall. What I like most is that it gives me spa-like results from home without irritation. A little goes a long way, and I only need to use it once or twice a week to see consistent improvements. Over time, I’ve found that my skin tone looks more even, and the appearance of fine lines has softened. It’s definitely become a favorite step in my skincare routine.
Received this today sealed no hole in bottle and not even half way full of product. Considering the price this is ridiculous!

avis.titre: Rather expensive face exfoliator cream with tons of micro abrasive particles
avis.texte: Dr. Brandt Advanced Microdermabrasion Face Exfoliator is described as a “spa-grade” face exfoliator cream that features aluminum oxide crystals and lactic acid. Since I use retinol, enzymes and AHAs for skin turnover, I didn’t use any products containing abrasive particles on my face, as I think physical exfoliation is too rough for my sensitive skin. I test this product on my hands and upper chest area. Here, alumina (aluminum oxide crystals) is at the second place in the ingredient list, providing a lot of these small abrasive particles, resulting in a super gritty feel when you apply the cream to your skin. It is a white cream with rather dense texture, easy to spread on the skin (should be used on damp skin). During application, it releases a distinct citric scent, like citronella or lemongrass. After 2 minutes of gentle massaging (scrubbing), the cream should be rinsed off. It does not leave any film-like sensation, the skin indeed fells smoother after it. Of course, lactic acid needs more than 2 minutes to do its job, so it is mainly physical exfoliation here plus smoothing components. Also, there is no information about actual concentration of the lactic acid here (but featured as the second key exfoliation ingredient); given it is listed after allantoin, it might be less than 1-2% here (not enough for exfoliation purposes). avis.titre: Gentle Exfoliator that get it done!
avis.texte: I’ve been using the Dr. Brandt Advanced Exfoliator for a few weeks now, and the results have been impressive. It’s a chemical-meets-physical exfoliant, combining gentle micro-exfoliating particles with alpha hydroxy acids (AHAs) to deeply cleanse and resurface the skin. What I love: Texture: It has a creamy, luxurious texture with fine exfoliating grains—not too harsh, even on sensitive skin. Effectiveness: My skin feels instantly smoother and looks brighter after each use. Over time, it helped reduce dullness and even out my skin tone. Pore appearance: Noticeable improvement in how clear and refined my pores look. No irritation: Despite being potent, it didn’t leave my skin red or stripped. What to watch for: Scent: It has a mild clinical smell—not unpleasant, but not for those sensitive to fragrance. Price: It’s on the pricier side, but a little goes a long way, and the results justify the cost for me. Not for daily use: Best used 2-3 times per week to avoid over-exfoliation. Final Verdict: If you’re looking for a high-performance exfoliator that delivers spa-like results at home, Dr. Brandt’s Advanced Exfoliator is worth the investment. Great for improving texture, tone, and glow without being overly abrasive

This Dr. Brandt Micro Derma-Brasion exfoliator does a nice job of giving you smooth, silky skin. It has a super light ‘scrubbing’ action. This is not a typical heavy, thick exfoliator. It has no scent. You only need a very tiny amount for your entire face. You do not need to scrub vigorously, just very lightly. A drawback is that the tube is only filled half-way. This product is way over-priced. The tube will not last long. If the tube was filled, it still would be very high-priced.

avis.titre: Creamy sandy texture that smooths patchy skin
avis.texte: Leaves skin feeling smooth and hydrated! Has a very fine sand-like texture in a cream form that exfoliates the skin. I find that this feels warming while massaging it into the skin, which I'm not sure if that's normal or not. It's not unbearable, but slightly uncomfortable and unexpected, as it wasn't mentioned in the description. I do use a retinol/ niacinamide-based night cream, and my skin can lean more sensitive at times, so maybe my skin is just being more reactive because of this. The bottle does state that it is not recommended for sensitive skin. It does make my skin smoother and has reduced my dry, flakey skin patches, but it leans on the pricey side for such a small bottle. I don't think it's the perfect match for my skin and budget but it does do its job!

his exfoliator makes my skin feel incredibly smooth after every use. The texture is fine but strong enough to polish away dry patches without irritation. It also helps my skin recover from tretinoin use, and I can literally see the dead skin cells gone by how soft and smooth my skin feels afterward. My face looks brighter immediately, and it has a light, clean scent that’s refreshing without being too strong. At $79 for the full size, it’s pricey, but a little goes a long way. If you want that fresh facial feel at home, this product really delivers.

avis.titre: Leaves Skin Feeling Smooth and Refreshed
avis.texte: The Dr. Brandt Advanced Microdermabrasion exfoliator feels like a high-end product that delivers a very polished, refreshed result after use. The texture has fine crystals that gently smooth the skin, and the formula spreads evenly so a small amount goes a long way. I like that it rinses off cleanly without leaving residue, and afterward my skin feels softer and looks more even. It has an unscented formula with added ingredients like jojoba and chamomile that make it feel less harsh than other exfoliators I have tried. At two ounces it is a smaller tube for the price, but the quality feels premium and a little product is enough for each session, which makes it last longer than expected.

This meets all my expectations on what a quality microdermabrasion cleanser should be and do. The exfoliating granules are very fine but make a difference in gently removing superficial dead layers of skin. After cleansing, it leaves my face feeling smooth and alive. The scent is very light and not overpowering. After only a couple uses I can feel the difference in the softness of my skin. If I've put a little too much in my hand for my face, I extend the cleanser down my chest, which needs exfoliating just as much if not more. I get rough spots on my chest and find I have less of them after a couple uses. Overall this performs better than expected and I plan to continue use after this bottle runs out.

This truly does feel like a spa experience to me. The scrub element of this is pretty abrasive, clearing away dead skin. The scrub is really fine and feels massaging and relaxing to me. The cleanser in this is gentle and makes my skin feel moisturized. I like the value of getting a spa experience at home. This scrub is very effective, but also gentle. It is a good quality scrub. It has a mild scent. I really enjoy this product.

Okay!! This product wow'd me and made me like this brand. Product came with foil safety seal intact. Using warm water I gently scrubbed the product around on my face for a couple minutes. After warm water Rinse , my skin felt so smooth, Glowing and fresh ! The product is not harsh to sensitive skin. But wow my face feels so rejuvenated & smooth!! Not an everyday product so will last a while and worth the price point considering the amazing results.

It took a little bit of time to arrive but I’m so happy it finally did! This Micro Derma Brasion Face Exfoliator by Dr. Brandt is amazing! I never realized how badly my face needed this but after using my skin felt like new! It has sand like texture that you apply to a wet face. Massage it in for two minutes and wash off. After using I have had no sensitivity issues and my skin felt so smooth. It did not dry my skin after using. This exfoliates is a bit pricey but in my opinion, worth every penny!

Honestly, the product was delivered in its best shape considering the high cost, the packaging box was quite thin and already damaged upon delivery. Fortunately, the tube was intact. It was sealed properly to give me a peace of mind. The scent of the cream was quite subtle and pleasant. It contains large amount of small beads, when rubbing on the skin it feels like very fine grained sand. It's satisfying to rub the dead skin out of my face and see it getting better, at least from my own perspective. I didn't feel any irritation or allergy. Attached photos please see how the product looked like and how it applied to skin on my hand. Great quality, strongly recommended!

I noticed my face feeling rough after all the foundations and creams I use so bought some exfoliating cleansing wipes. They didn’t do much at all, but this cream worked well to smooth my skin and make it glowing. It even seemed to diminish the appearance of some old acne scars. I’m pretty impressed, since I’m not the type to go in for facials but like something simple I can use at home. And I experienced no irritation even though my face is prone to redness. A great product that my face treatment regimen was lacking, though I’d recommend buying when on sale.

I’ve tried many exfoliators and Microderm abrasion formulas. This one is by far my favorite. My skin loves it! The beads are so tiny and fine in texture. You feel like you’re getting into every area of your face that means exfoliating. 2 minutes of rubbing it in did not cause any irritation. My advice would be to follow directions and make sure your skin is wet prior to applying.
